card.name: Linking words before drug or treatment terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "by" and "&" that come right after a noun like use, effectiveness, mL or removed, and just before a drug, fluid or procedure name. Also the start of "pimozide" and the word "gastric" before lavage.

modes.label: Of after a noun
modes.description: The word "of" follows a noun such as use, effectiveness or mL and leads into a drug or substance.
modes.example: Concomitant use<< of>> CHCs with metabolic concentrations of the estrogen

modes.label: Removed by dialysis
modes.description: The word "by" follows "removed" and leads into dialysis or hemodialysis.
modes.example: Telmisartan is not removed<< by>> hemodialysis.

modes.label: Start of pimozide
modes.description: The first letter of pimozide in lists of drugs that interact.
modes.example: ole, cisapride, or<< p>>imozide is contraindicated
